structured.answer: The page says to hold it in a Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) account in the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500" fund. With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, that comes to about 179,889 ₪ "in today's money" out of 135,000 ₪ put in. It assumes 2% inflation a year, plus a 7% yearly return and a steady dollar, so I'd ask my son before doing it.
